## How was it checked?

- [ ] `swift run interview lint` reports 0 problems
- [ ] `swift test` passes
- [ ] New or changed code in an answer has a test named after the question ID
- [ ] Each new technical answer cites a primary source
- [ ] `questions/README.md` and the README counts are updated if questions were added
- [ ] `flutter test` (answers/flutter) or `npm test` (answers/react-native) pass, if those changed
- [ ] Screenshots regenerated with `scripts/capture-screens.sh` if the app changed
- [ ] README translations updated, or noted here if `README.md` changed
